climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A region in the North East Victoria zone, around Lake Mokoan, with vines first planted in 1866. Phylloxera hit in the 1890s, but vineyards were quickly replanted on resistant rootstocks. Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon are each 32 percent of plantings.
